messages:
Aisha: hey team :wave: looping you on a Xenia POC request — they want to trial a Llama45B q4_k variant in a Private (VPC) Dedicated environment. Main asks: Dedicated pricing estimate, KV-cache support (long context ~8k), EU-only data residency, and compatibility with our current runtime. any immediate blockers?

Luca: quick clarifying q's — is the model coming as GGUF/GGML? do they expect persistent KV cache across restarts? avg tokens/request and expected concurrency?

Aisha: model artifact will be provided by customer (they said GGUF). persistent KV across restarts preferred. target concurrency 6–8 rps, avg payload ~600 tokens, spikes to 2k tokens.

Priya: high level infra notes — Llama45B q4_k will still need substantial VRAM with 8k context. rough estimate: 1x H100-80GB might be tight for sustained 6–8 rps with KV cache; prefer 2x 80GB or a single 160GB equivalent. persistent KV cache -> recommend NVMe-backed local cache or NFS with pinned instances. also need to confirm mlock and swap policies for q4 variants.

Marco: security checklist — EU-only tenancy ok (private deployment). need to confirm: KMS integration for keys, client-side tokenization/PII rules, and completed security questionnaire. they require SOC2 + contractual DPA and SSO via SAML. any data egress to US?

Oliver: product note — we don't have Llama45B in catalog yet. onboarding steps: model artifact (gguf), tokenizer files, a small eval set + perf expectations, and sample prompts for safety checks. suggest we create two catalog variants: `llama45b-q4_k` and `llama45b-fp16` (fallback). also propose a canary routing policy to fallback to 30B if capacity is constrained.

Luca: i can run a local dry-compat test. items I need from customer: download link (s3), sha256, tokenizer.json, and a short eval prompt set (~20 prompts). i can then run our runtime runner with `--kv-cache` and `--context 8192`.

Aisha: noted — i'll ask customer for those assets. also flag on pricing: they asked for 1-year reserved Dedicated commit, 24/7 SLA.

Priya: pricing/ops constraint — reserved pool for this size model likely sits in our high-cost tier. i'll estimate baseline infra and ops overhead and share numbers tomorrow.

Marco: i'll send security questionnaire and start scoping compliance gaps. please add contact for their security PM.

deploy-bot: Preflight scan queued for artifact `s3://xenia-models/llama45b-q4k-v1.gguf` — job id 78192. Expected model size: 41.8 GB (on-disk q4_k). Host runtime compat scan will run after artifact is downloaded.

Luca: sample runtime command i'll run (for reference):
```
redwood-runner --model /tmp/llama45b.gguf --quant q4_k --context 8192 --kv-cache enabled --batch 4 --gpu 2
```

Aisha: next steps / owners:
- Aisha: collect artifact link + security contact (ETA: today EOD)
- Luca: run compatibility + perf smoke tests once artifact is in (ETA: +24h after assets)
- Priya: infra sizing + initial Dedicated pricing estimate (ETA: tomorrow)
- Marco: start security questionnaire + list of required docs (ETA: today)
- Oliver: create placeholder catalog entry and variant IDs so sales/legal refs have names (ETA: tomorrow)

Luca: small note — if KV persistence is required across restarts, we need to design eviction/rehydration. that's an infra engineering task, not instant.

Aisha: thanks all — i'll post customer asset link here when i have it. tagging @Luca @Priya @Marco @Oliver. :thumbsup:
